# netcup_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages DNS zone settings for an existing netcup domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_dns_zone" "example" {
  domain_name = "example.com"
  ttl         = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain name of the DNS zone.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to live (TTL) for all records in the zone, in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `dnssec_status` (Boolean) DNSSEC status of the zone.
- `expire` (String) Expire time of the zone.
- `refresh` (String) Refresh interval of the zone.
- `retry` (String) Retry interval of the zone.
- `serial` (String) Serial number of the zone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# terraform import netcup_dns_zone.example example.com
```
